source_reference_role: Approved static design used for composition and painted material style. Generated assets are reference-edited candidates, not a claim of original pixel extraction or complete runtime implementation.

atlas_entries.name: paper_frame
atlas_entries.note: Outside and inner aperture use generated real alpha. Draw photo under the aperture; the bottom border remains blank for runtime stamps. No runtime curl, shadow, stamp, or text is painted here.
atlas_entries.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS, straight RGBA result, no background matte or alpha threshold

atlas_entries.name: wooden_selector_clip
atlas_entries.note: One complete wooden spring clothespin, diagonal lower-left to upper-right. No tag, string, text, floor or cast shadow. Draw the two Home slot labels separately.
atlas_entries.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS, straight RGBA result, no background matte or alpha threshold

base_plate.transformation: Byte-identical PNG copy, no resize or recompression.
base_plate.note: At 720x1280 logical canvas this is 1.307 image pixels per logical pixel; the base alone does not establish full-canvas DPR2. It supports DPR2 up to approximately 470 logical pixels wide without upscaling.
base_plate.contents: Warm plaster, white-flowered green vines, low wooden trim, wooden plank floor, one empty braided straw mat. No window, photograph, photo rope, clip, typography, plaque, character or paper stack.
base_plate.lighting: Soft neutral warm material appearance. No directional light beam or hard sun shaft. Restrained intrinsic ambient/material shading remains; runtime directional lighting and shadows belong to the integrator.

package_intent: photo_visual; integrator must assign to the actual delayed photo pack and ensure Home first load does not depend on this namespace.

visual_inspection.packed_atlas_inspection: Viewed after assembly with view_image. Frame aperture and empty atlas space are truly alpha=0; sample wooden clip interior alpha=253. No matte was introduced. Atlas-region RGBA hashes match the independently resized input regions.
visual_inspection.finding: Generated plate removes baked UI, photo content and fish while preserving the approved vine/white-flower/plaster/floor/mat composition. Clip is complete with wood and metal spring. Paper frame has a transparent aperture and no text or content.

official_godot_4_5_2_lossless_import.required: Import both runtime PNGs with pinned official engine, mipmaps disabled, no size limit; compare decoded RGBA8 base with runtime_files rgba8_sha256. This asset preparation does not claim importer, rendered game or dynamic light acceptance.
